title: Golf Round Strokes Gained Import Freshness Gap
dataSources: Golf rounds (`golf:round`), Garmin golf telemetry (`garmin:golf`), UDisc rounds (`udisc:round`), launch-monitor shots (`launchmonitor:shot`), handicap-index updates (`handicap:index`).
app: Arccos and Garmin S62 round telemetry, UDisc round exports, launch-monitor CSVs, and handicap-index updates streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=golf:round
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by player
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects athletes, devices, or exports that have stopped sending golf round strokes gained data within the expected freshness window.
value: Stale performance data hides missed sessions and broken syncs, so a freshness alert protects the trend lines you rely on.
implementation: Review this at least daily and tune the freshness threshold to the normal cadence of the underlying app or export job.
visualization: Table of player values by hours since the last golf round strokes gained event.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when data for golf round strokes gained has stopped arriving and probably needs a sync check.
